findings.citationQuote: We are a dry-format house. Our presses turn out compacts and pressed powders, solid sticks, and cream-to-powder hybrids. We do not currently operate any fluid-filling capability, and serums are outside what this site can produce; a fluid line appears on our capital plan for 2027 but is not yet commissioned.
findings.reasoning: The document explicitly states the supplier only manufactures dry-format cosmetics (compacts, pressed powders, solid sticks, cream-to-powder hybrids) and has no fluid-filling capability, with serums explicitly stated as outside current production capability. A fluid line is only planned for 2027 and not yet commissioned. This directly contradicts the requirement for documented experience producing liquid/serum skincare formulations.

findings.citationQuote: Cosmetics GMP is certified to ISO 22716:2007 under certificate IN-COS-22716-0655, issued 10 November 2023 and valid through 9 November 2026.
findings.reasoning: The document provides an actual certificate record including a certificate identifier (IN-COS-22716-0655), issue date, and validity date, so this is not merely a marketing claim. The stated validity end date is reported as the expiry per the requirement's instructions.

findings.citationQuote: Minimum first run is three thousand pieces.
findings.reasoning: The document states the minimum first order run as three thousand pieces, reported here as the numeric MOQ value with the unit as stated in the document ('pieces').

findings.citationQuote: Of twenty-four audited runs, twenty passed and four were rejected — about seventeen per cent rejected.
findings.reasoning: The document reports that of twenty-four audited production runs, four were rejected, stated as 'about seventeen per cent rejected,' which is reported here as the historical quality inspection fail rate. A separate figure ('Mean defect level on passing runs was 1.05 per cent') refers to a different metric (defect level on passing runs, not fail rate) and is not used for this requirement.

findings.citationQuote: Manufacturing takes eleven calendar days on average once artwork is approved.
findings.reasoning: The document states the average manufacturing lead time as eleven calendar days once artwork is approved, reported here as the stated numeric value.

findings.citationQuote: Thirteen years in operation from our site in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
